## What is Chilgoza?

Chilgoza (also spelled Chilghoza; scientific name Pinus gerardiana) is a distinctive variety of pine nut native to the mountain ranges of Pakistan, Afghanistan, and northern India. It grows at altitudes of 1,800–3,350 metres in the sub-alpine forests of the Hindu Kush and Himalayas. Unlike the round Italian pine nut (Pinus pinea), Chilgoza is slender and elongated, with a richer, more buttery flavour. It is traditionally consumed shell-on — the ritual of cracking each nut by hand is considered part of the experience.

**Nutritional highlights:**
- High in monounsaturated fats (oleic acid) — heart-healthy
- Rich in protein (approximately 14g per 100g)
- Good source of magnesium, zinc, and vitamin E
- Contains pinolenic acid, associated with appetite suppression
- No cholesterol; low glycaemic

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is Chilgoza?**
A: Chilgoza is a slender, buttery pine nut (Pinus gerardiana) native to Pakistan's mountain ranges. It is traditionally enjoyed shell-on, cracking each nut by hand. It is richer and more flavourful than Italian pine nuts.

**Q: Are the pine nuts sold shell-on?**
A: Yes. All Al Janat products are shell-on, as is traditional. The shell protects freshness and is part of the experience.

**Q: How should I store Chilgoza?**
A: Cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly. Refrigerate for up to 3 months or freeze for up to 6 months.

**Q: Do you ship across Pakistan?**
A: Yes, nationwide delivery via trusted courier partners. Free delivery on orders above PKR 10,000.

**Q: Are the pine nuts healthy?**
A: Yes. Rich in protein, healthy fats, magnesium, zinc, and vitamin E. No additives or preservatives. 100% natural.

**Q: Can I order a gift set for Eid or weddings?**
A: Yes. The Al Janat Gift Box (2kg) is specifically designed for Eid, weddings, and corporate gifting, with a gift tin, forest-green box, and satin ribbon.
